snippet.title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials - Official Demo Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Demo Gameplay Trailer for 13Z: The Zodiac Trials, a fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike developed by Mixed Realms. Players will master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac. 13Z: The Zodiac Trials is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo running from June 1 through June 25 on PC (Steam).
